result.reason: The revision reduces the non-renewal notice period from 180 days to 30 days, satisfying the fallback requirement of no more than 60 days. The existing fee-increase cap—lesser of CPI and 3%—is more protective than the fallback 5% cap. Although the clause does not add the 60-day renewal reminder required by the preferred position, it reaches the fallback with a single, targeted change and preserves the remaining commercial terms.
